name: Truth or Dare
description: Add the players, pick a level from kids to bold, and let the phone choose truths and dares.
prompt: A Truth or Dare game for groups: add players, choose kids, friends or bold level, it picks whose turn it is and shows a truth or a dare card, all fun and friendly.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Añade a los jugadores, elige un nivel de niños a atrevido y deja que el móvil elija verdades y retos.
